description: Land Acquisition - Algama, Weerambugedara D/S Division, Kurunegala District (Lots 1 - 49)
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels to be acquired by the state for public purposes.
